Refreshing the browser is not enoug"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"h — Node modules stay in memory."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The default model can be set in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Use an id the region actually lists: the model list is whatever that region's live catalog returns, "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"so a pinned default can become stale. `hy3` is free in both regions at the time of writing."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How sign-in works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Each region uses the official CLI auth endpoints independently:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. `POST /v2/plugin/auth/state?platform=CLI&nonce=` (international `www.workbuddy.ai`, domestic `cop"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ilot.tencent.com`)
2. Open the returned `authUrl`
3. Poll `GET /v2/plugin/auth/token?state=` (upstre"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"am returns `11217` while still pending)
4. The token is written to the region's plugin copy: interna"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"tional `$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-ai-auth.json`, domestic `$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-cn-auth.json`"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The desktop app's `workbuddy-desktop-ai.info` (international) and `workbuddy-desktop.info` (domestic"},{"id":"p19s2","text":") are read-only — the plugin never writes them. It only stores its own per-region credential copies "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"obtained through OAuth."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The settings card lists every imported account. Switching only affects subsequent requests; in-fligh"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"t requests keep using the original account, and bulk credit/check-in operations do not change the cu"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"using the original account, and bulk credit/check-in operations do not change the current selection."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Disconnect** / `logout` only deletes that region's own plugin credentials; the desktop app is unto"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"onnect** / `logout` only deletes that region's own plugin credentials; the desktop app is untouched."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Settings → Plugins → **DSH WorkBuddy**:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Connect / Disconnect**: per-region browser sign-in, or delete that region's plugin credentials
-"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" Domestic/international account lists, official edition badges, explicit switching, remaining credit"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"s, and a connectivity test
- Tick domestic personal accounts for auto check-in (off by default); edu"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"cation accounts do not expose check-in controls
- The active account refreshes read-only every 15 mi"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"nutes and others every 60 minutes by default — configurable
- **Free models only** (default) / **All"},{"id":"p24s6","text":" others every 60 minutes by default — configurable
- **Free models only** (default) / **All models**"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Or configure it in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Environment variables:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Variable | Effect |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| `DSH_WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE` | Override the international desktop credential path (OAuth credentials "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"still go to the plugin's own file) |
| `DSH_WORKBUDDY_CN_AUTH_FILE` | Override the domestic desktop "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"lugin's own file) |
| `DSH_WORKBUDDY_CN_AUTH_FILE` | Override the domestic desktop credential path |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## CLI"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"`status` / `doctor` accept `--json`. `logout` only deletes `$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy-ai-auth.json`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Symptom | Fix |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| No card in settings / no WorkBuddy in the model list | Restart `dsh web`; refreshing the browser i"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"s not enough |
| `dsh web` exits after clicking Connect | On headless Linux without `xdg-open`, upda"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"te to a build with spawn `error` handling; use the sign-in link on the card |
| 403 `request-not-tru"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"sted` when opening the card over a LAN IP | Add that IP/hostname to `allowedHosts`; do not put it in"},{"id":"p35s5","text":" the loopback list |
| Signed in but no models | The region's catalog request failed or returned not"},{"id":"p35s6","text":"hing — check connectivity and whether the token is still valid; the list stays empty rather than bor"},{"id":"p35s7","text":"rowing the other region's models |
| `doctor` says signed-out | Run `login` first, or confirm the in"},{"id":"p35s8","text":"ternational desktop app is signed in |
